Day trips

La Ciotat & Route des Crêtes

Just 15 minutes from Cassis, La Ciotat offers spectacular views, wild coves and authentic Provençal charm.

15 min by car from Cassis

La Ciotat, the town next door to Cassis, is famous for its dizzying cliffs, unspoilt calanques and cinema heritage — it was here that the Lumière brothers filmed L'Arrivée d'un train en gare de La Ciotat (The Arrival of a Train at La Ciotat Station). The Route des Crêtes, which links Cassis and La Ciotat, is one of the most beautiful panoramic roads in France.

Things to see

The must-sees

From the panoramic road to hidden coves, every stop holds a surprise.

Our favourite

The Route des Crêtes

15 kilometres of panoramic road between Cassis and La Ciotat, rising to 400 metres above sea level on the cliffs of Cap Canaille — the highest sea cliffs in France. Stunning views over the sea, the islands and the calanques.

Car-free every Sunday — ideal for walking or cycling
Discover the road

Calanque de Figuerolles

A small cove tucked between the rocks, within walking distance of the centre of La Ciotat. Crystal-clear water, rocks sculpted by erosion and the famous ‘Rocher du Capucin’ standing guard.

On foot — 15 min from Le Mugel
Find out more

Calanque du Mugel

A small cove with turquoise water, nestled at the foot of the Bec de l'Aigle and sheltered by puddingstone cliffs. You reach it through a listed botanical park (exotic garden, shady paths). A pebble beach that's ideal for swimming and snorkelling.

Free access through the park — Open all year round
Find out more

La Ciotat old town

Colourful lanes, shady squares, the church of Notre-Dame-de-l'Assomption and the old fishing harbour. Don't miss the Sunday morning market on the harbour. A charming, authentic stroll.

Spend 1 to 2 hours wandering the historic centre
Not to be missed

The Île Verte

The only wooded island in Provence, reached by boat from the port of La Ciotat (a 15 min crossing). Walking trails, coves for swimming and a restaurant on the island. A little paradise.

Shuttle boat from the harbour — 15 min crossing
